title: Synthetic stand-up: three people, one on the mic
lines: Morning both. Let's keep this short. Priya, do you want to start?
Sure. I finished the migration script for the billing tables yesterday. It runs cleanly on staging, but it takes about forty minutes on the full data set.
Forty minutes is too long for a deploy window. Can we split it into batches?
Yes, I think so. I'll split it into batches of ten thousand rows and rerun it on staging today.
Good. Marco, what about the login bug?
I found it. The session cookie was being set without the secure flag on the preview domain, so Safari dropped it. The fix is a one line change. I'll open the pull request this morning.
Great. Is that the same issue Alcatraz was flagging last week?
Same root cause, yes. Alcatraz checks the cookie flags on every preview deploy, which is how we spotted it.
One thing from me. We still haven't decided whether the export feature ships behind a flag.
Let's decide now. I'd rather ship it behind a flag and turn it on for the design team first.
Agreed. Flag first, then everyone next week if nothing breaks.
Fine by me. I'll add the flag when I do the batching change.
And I'll write the note to the design team so they know it's coming. Anything else?
